source_index_lines: - [[soundstage-triangle-esprit-comete-40th]] — SoundStage! review by Diego Estan, 2021-09-15 (Tier D)
brand_notes: Triangle (France). Borea range made in China; 40th Anniversary models made in France (soundstage-triangle-esprit-comete-40th). Triangle US sells direct at trianglehifi.us with deep sale discounts (Comete 40th $1,900 vs $2,750; Theta $1,450/unit vs $2,400). Horn-loaded tweeters, cellulose paper cones; claims 90 dB sensitivity but NRC measured 88.0 dB for Comete 40th and ~3.6 Ω min vs 4.2 claimed. Maker says speakers 'never fall below 3 Ω'. Theta claims 3.4 Ω min. Borea BR03 had bright treble per SoundStage. Shipping damage to cabinets reported in one Ez review on maker page (anecdote).
takeaways: NRC anechoic: 88.0 dB sensitivity (claimed 90), LW about ±3.3 dB with dip near 4 kHz (graph-read)
Bass drops steeply below ~90 Hz anechoic; f3 ~72 Hz graph-read vs 49 Hz claimed; in-room -3 dB 38 Hz per reviewer
Impedance min ~3.6 Ω at ~200 Hz (graph-read) so flagged effectively-4ohm; claimed 4.2 Ω
Estan: rich smooth mids, neutral treble, light bass
Other four Triangle packets have no Tier A/B data
conflicts: Crossover 3.8 kHz (review) vs garbled maker text
log_bullets: Conflict: sensitivity 88.0 vs 90 claimed; min impedance ~3.6 vs 4.2 claimed
Triangle BR04, Comete Ez, Solstice 3, Signature Theta: no-tier-ab (mfr raw saved only)
